subject: PO line-grouping, weekly settlement and discount banding
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@aopsystems.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aopsystems.com
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO header/line requirements + weekly settlement feasibility

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at AOP has reviewed your pricing decks and we need to align on a couple of operational constraints before we can issue an order. Our AP/ERP requires the following on every invoice:

- PO number and PO line grouping: each invoice line must map to a PO line id (we cannot accept multiple logical deliverables under one freeform line).
- Billing entity and BU code must be present as separate fields on the invoice (we have shared an ERP extract that maps BU codes to our internal GL).
- Invoice cadence: we prefer weekly settlement runs for SaaS usage billing (our vendor onboarding team can support weekly runs if invoices include the PO line grouping).
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for our vendor roster.

We're also evaluating your proposed discount bands. For evaluation we need to confirm whether discounts are applied at the invoice level or at the aggregated monthly statement.

Attached: AOP_PO_template.pdf (sample of required header/line format).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) emit invoices with PO line ids per your billing lane (one invoice file per weekly run), and
2) apply discount bands based on the cumulative invoice run (weekly vs monthly)?

If weekly settlement isn't possible, we need a workaround (e.g., a weekly CSV summary + monthly invoice) so our AP can still reconcile.

Thanks,
Maria Ortega
Senior Procurement Manager
AOP Systems

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@aopsystems.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header/line requirements + weekly settlement feasibility

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the clarity and the sample template. Short answers up front: yes to PO line ids, and we can support banded discounts, but we need to agree how aggregation is calculated. A few details and asks below so we can confirm a clean handoff to billing/finance:  

- Invoices with PO line ids: our billing pipeline can include a PO_line_id column on each invoice row. We typically emit a single invoice per billing run per billing entity; supporting weekly runs is technically feasible but will increase per-invoice processing and could affect our minimum settlement threshold.

- Discount application: we support applying discounts either per invoice (for that invoice's tokens/usage) or as an end-of-period credit applied on the monthly statement. If AOP needs discounts calculated on cumulative weekly runs, we can either:  
  * Evaluate against a rolling 30-day window and apply credits on the next monthly invoice, or
  * Calculate and issue weekly credit memos once a band is crossed (adds operational work and reporting).

- Net terms: our standard hosted terms are Net30. We can accept Net45 for enterprise deals, typically in exchange for a modest pricing concession (or early-pay discount structure). Can you confirm whether Net45 is a hard requirement?

Next steps I'd propose:
1) Ben/Grace and I will review the attached PO template and return a sample Redwood invoice row mapping by EOD Monday.
2) If Net45 is mandatory, let's confirm the discount concession we should offer so finance can update the order form.
3) If weekly settlement must be literal (invoice posted every 7 days), confirm whether AOP can accept monthly aggregation for discount qualification and we issue weekly invoices for payment/reconciliation.

Attaching a short extract of our billing fields (redwood-billing-lane-excerpt.xlsx) for mapping.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts (West)
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@aopsystems.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header/line requirements + weekly settlement feasibility

Hi Kimberly, Ben, Grace —

Appreciate the quick reply. A few clarifications from Procurement/ERP:  

- Net45 is standard for our contracts and is a gating requirement for SOWs over $75k annually. We can discuss exceptions, but that will need AP leadership sign-off.

- Discount bands: we calculate eligibility based on net spend within the billing month (calendar month). If your credit approach is monthly aggregation, that's acceptable — we only need the applied credits to be visible on the month-end statement so our accruals team can reconcile.

- Weekly settlement: the key ERP constraint is that each weekly invoice must include the PO line id and the BU code exactly as in the attached PO template. If Redwood can output that structure, we can run weekly settlements. If not, we'd need a weekly CSV that maps Redwood invoice line ids -> AOP PO lines plus a monthly invoice for payment.

Accounts payable contact is John Stevens (john.stevens@aopsystems.com) — he'll need to see the sample invoice.

Two asks for Redwood:  
1) Provide a sample weekly invoice (CSV or PDF) populated with our template fields so our onboarding team can validate ingest.
2) Clarify the commercial tradeoff if we require Net45 instead of Net30 (we need a numeric concession to present to our finance committee).

Thanks,
Maria

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@aopsystems.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header/line requirements + weekly settlement feasibility

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the details and for looping John. On commercial concessions: we can accommodate Net45 as a standard on this deal if AOP agrees to one of the following (pick one):

- Option A (volume-first): Commit to a 12-month minimum ARR of $120k and we'll hold list prices but increase the discount floor by 3 percentage points across your tiers (e.g., if base tier is 5%, tier bumped to 8%).
- Option B (early-pay mix): Keep a 12-month commitment at $100k ARR and keep discounts as-is, but Redwood will offer a 1.25% early-pay discount for payments made within 15 days of invoice. Net45 still stands as the default.

Operational items: we will produce a sample weekly invoice CSV matching your PO template and send it to John and Procurement. If weekly credit application is required to be monthly-aggregated, we'll do month-end credits and include a reconciliation file so AOP's accruals team can reconcile.  

Kimberly/Grace: I can draft the concession language for the order form once Maria confirms which option they prefer.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: John Stevens <john.stevens@aopsystems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@aopsystems.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header/line requirements + weekly settlement feasibility

Thanks team — quick note from AP:

- We reviewed Ben's options. Finance favors Option A (12-month $120k commit + +3pp on discount bands) as it simplifies accrual treatment. Can you circulate a redlined order form that reflects Option A and Net45?

- For onboarding, please send the sample weekly invoice CSV to ap-uploads@aopsystems.com. We'll validate ingest and confirm whether any field mapping is required.

- PO numbering: we'll issue a master PO referencing the billing header (AOP-ENT-2026-4719) and individual PO lines for each deliverable. Please ensure your sample uses this PO header in both the PO_number and PO_header fields.

John Stevens
Accounts Payable Director
AOP Systems

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: John Stevens <john.stevens@aopsystems.com>, Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@aopsystems.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header/line requirements + weekly settlement feasibility

John/Maria —

Great — we'll proceed with Option A as the commercial baseline and update the order form. Action items and owners:  

- Ben: prepare redline of order form reflecting 12-month commitment at $120k ARR, Net45, and +3pp discount band uplift. (Due: Tue EOD)
- Grace: export sample weekly invoice CSV mapped to AOP_PO_template fields and send to ap-uploads@aopsystems.com (Due: Mon morning). Include a short reconciliation mapping document.
- Kimberly (me): I'll prepare a mutual action plan and share a DocuSign link for the order form once Ben's redline is ready.

Please confirm the PO header you'll issue (John suggested AOP-ENT-2026-4719) and whether we should expect a master PO before signature or if AOP prefers signature then PO issuance.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting onboarding scheduled as soon as we validate the CSV.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts (West)
Redwood Inference
